depth.source: official MP3D textured mesh at the oracle camera
depth.encoding: raw uint16 = metres*4000, 0 = no surface; colour reversed TURBO (red near, blue far, black none)

surface_normals: mesh normals in oracle-camera axes: R right, G up, B toward camera; -1..1 -> 0..255
panorama: native skybox ERP at the oracle capture point, 2048x1024, oracle heading at the centre

stops: the oracle view (between the two images)
